name: WordPal - Vocabulary Builder
description:
Make building your vocabulary fun and simple with WordPal.

WordPal is a useful app that can be used to improve your English vocabulary, whether it be to help you sound more intelligent, directly in exams, in word games such as Scrabble or Boggle, with creative writing or anything else.

After downloading the app, you will be able to enjoy the many features WordPal has to offer for free:
- Pick the synonym of the word given from multiple choice
